title: 3D Anchor to Video Generation: Controlled Diffusion via First-Frame Injection
hypothesis: Injecting a 3D-rendered orthographic frame as Anchor into video diffusion models (Veo 2 / Seedance / Wan 2.1) significantly reduces structural drift and enables precise camera trajectory control compared to text-only generation.
